title: Avoid episode leakage
scope: Group-disjoint split reasoning, not generalization measurement

items.prompt: Frame records retain episode IDs. Training episodes=['e1', 'e2']; held-out episodes=['e2', 'e3']. Does this split have episode overlap? Return yes or no. Statistics must be fitted on training records only.
items.solution: Intersection=['e2']. Splitting frames from the same episode across sets leaks episode-specific context.
hints: Identify the requested quantity and its units before calculating.
Write the equation using the supplied inputs, then check units and signs.
